correctness.rationale: For a vector x, y, bracket [x,y]=x1y1 e2. Basis-pair RB defects yield b²=0 and a²−2ad=0 with other equations vanishing once b=0. Over any field b=0; in odd characteristic a=0 or a=2d yields two planes meeting along c, while in char2 a=0 yields one plane set-theoretically (scheme may be nonreduced). Aut fixes [e1,e1], hence phi(e1)=u e1+v e2 and phi(e2)=u² e2 (u nonzero), and conjugation sends c to uc+v(a−d)/u. Distinct a,d are orbit invariants and all c can be killed when a−d≠0. Normal forms 0,E21,D_d and H_d where char≠2 yield 2q orbits, and in char2 just q+1. Direct enumeration of all endomorphisms over F2,F3,F5,F7 reproduced 4,15,45,91 maps; orbit sizes follow from explicit action, not finite trials.
